content: 247/335 PRs are awaiting-authornot getting fixed, and a lot of them from a few owners that I see active and making reviews. I suspect they run the worker loop and a bug is emerging. A similar bug was reported (110) but closed. I myself do not loop the worker.
I addressed mine a different way; I don't think it's a worker bug.

Thanks for fixing.

@Kim Morrison 91 of 226 open PR's awaiting-author are from your(?) tauceti-ai-for-science bot. Please fix.
@Erik (√2, sqrt-of-2) 70 of 226 are from you/your bot. Please fix.

In my case, I had an issue that caused my open PRs to climb to 26 PRs last week. Essentially, an issue with my Anthropic/Claude Oauth token caused my worker to run fix several times on each PR and fail every time. So my ATTEMPTS on each PR (technically, on each terminal commit) went above MAX_FIX_ATTEMPT, so my worker gave up on that PR and started a new one.

I fixed this by temporarily raising MAX_FIX_ATTEMPT. I don't know if this same issue has plagued anyone else. I have made some changes to my worker so that it functions in a tiny cloud computer, so perhaps my situation ins unique.
